title: Preselect Vs Select Events And Chrome
description: Separate preselect (rectangle/lasso drag) from committed select; preselect secondary = anchor minus preselect; preselectCancel on Escape; onPreselect/onPreselectCancel events in TS.
summary: Fixed flickering/wrong highlight during rectangle preselect: descriptor JSON now encodes only committed selection (never preview chrome), descriptor sync skips rebuilding selection while preselect is active, style resolution treats all preselect ids as Selected, hover is suppressed during preselect, and descriptor push is deferred while preselect is non-empty.
